name: not-adjudicated-c-no-ppw-block
why: route (c) via validity condition (4): an epoch whose pins.json carries no ppW block is not a valid epoch. A-1.12 wires (4) to route (c) explicitly so an instrument defect cannot fall through "any route not listed is a MISS" — and keeps it under the own-goal clause, which is what makes a harness misconfigured by its author a MISS rather than a free pass.
